summary: The recorded base reproduces the reported ZeroDivisionError when HF3FS receives bytes_per_page=0 from an actual LogicalHostPool. At the exact candidate commit, the factory supplies a one-byte marker only for a pool with kv_buffer=None, HF3FS stores that marker through its primary v1 path, and named v2 pools continue to carry physical bytes. The submitted regression passed, and an independent adversarial test verified anchor gating, missing-side-pool prefix truncation, and physical side-pool byte restoration. The candidate changes Python only; no native rebuild was applicable.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual repository LogicalHostPool reported kv_buffer=None and bytes_per_page=0; HiCacheHF3FS.__init__ raised the issue's ZeroDivisionError at file_size // bytes_per_page. The imported sglang path was /job/repo/python/sglang/__init__.py.
Candidate regression: factory marker geometry, mock HF3FS marker round trip, zero-sized physical primary discrimination, and direct non-positive constructor rejection; 4 passed.

Seven tests passed. Independent cases wrote logical anchor markers plus named v2 physical bytes, observed a one-page hit when the second side-pool component was absent, then wrote it and restored both physical pages byte-for-byte. Also confirmed a zero-sized named physical side pool still raises ZeroDivisionError, which is outside the valid DSV4 geometry and original failure path.
Candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: The failure and fix are CPU-side storage initialization and mock file/metadata operations. The assigned GPU was detected as AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but no GPU computation was needed or claimed.

remaining_counterexamples: Outside the original DSV4 contract, register_mem_host_pool_v2 still raises ZeroDivisionError rather than the new diagnostic ValueError if a named physical side pool itself reports zero bytes per page. Valid DSV4 physical side pools are non-zero, so this does not invalidate the original-issue fix.
remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek-V4 weights were available, so full model startup and semantic serving were not reproduced.
No deployed HF3FS cluster or hf3fs_fuse Python module was available; real usrbio I/O was not exercised. Mock HF3FS file I/O and repository metadata logic were exercised.
The available architecture is AMD gfx950/ROCm 7.2, not the issue reporter's NVIDIA Blackwell/CUDA environment.
Only one GPU was assigned, so the reported TP=2/distributed configuration was not reproduced.
No native files changed between the recorded base and candidate; therefore a native rebuild was not applicable.
